newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 745 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 745 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade said its Project A overnight agricultural contracts trading volume totaled 745 contracts, compared with 276 contracts traded overnight Tuesday.
There were 66 wheat, 349 corn, 284 soybean, 20 soymeal, one soyoil, one oat, 10 wheat call, two corn put and 12 soybean calls were traded.
In overnight trading, corn was steady to 1/2 cent higher, wheat 1-1/2 to two cents higher and soybeans steady to 3/4 cent higher.
